There's a lot to unpack in that sentence. In today's '**First Draft** ,' we'll

the powers that be seem entirely unsure how to cope; there are signs of a

For days, some officials in President Trump's government have been whispering
- to one another, to members of the media, the usual suspects - about
classified U.S. intel regarding Iran, Washington, DC, and supposed dirty-bomb-
assassination schemes. (**Zeteo** knows this because we've been on the
receiving end of some of it.) It's stuff out of a Tom Clancy novel, only if
the main characters were degenerate podcasters and adulterous game-show hosts.

By this point, perhaps you've seen the CNN story from Monday,
[reading](https://www.cnn.com/2026/11/16/politics/us-intelligence-iran-dirty-
bomb): **" New U.S. intelligence indicates that Iran is developing plans to
target senior Trump administration officials by detonating a so-called dirty
bomb or a chemical weapon in Washington, DC, even as officials continue to
debate whether Iran can or will attempt to execute such a plot, according to
seven U.S. officials."**

The article also notes that **" the plotting picked up by the U.S. has been
very specific and includes locations and targets, two of the sources said, and
has sparked a flurry of U.S. contingency planning."**

On Tuesday, President Trump publicly weighed in, saying
[during](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/17/trump-iran-dirty-bomb-
washington.html) an overseas trip: **" Well, if there is [an Iranian dirty-
bomb plot], they will pay a price the likes of which no country has ever paid
before."** He added: **" I hope it's not, but we take it very seriously,
because they happen to be crazy."**

Here's why you should remain highly skeptical.

**Zeteo** has spoken to multiple sources familiar with, or briefed on, the
classified intel at the heart of this kerfuffle. It does exist, but to be
clear: The U.S. intelligence community, including the National
Counterterrorism Center, reviews raw intelligence of varying degrees of
credibility regarding threats to the U.S. homeland and so forth on a near-
constant basis.
